title: ODDFYIELD: no figure exists; three witnesses diverge, the worst at 3.7e6 ULP

upstream_anchor.section: Validation (live Excel 16.0 b20026, G6 three-way ledger: OxFunc / F# / Excel)

status_plain: ODDFYIELD has no pass figure of any kind. It inverts a now bit-exact price through a solver, and the solvers differ: OxFunc bisects from zero while Excel uses Newton from a guess. All three ledger witnesses diverge, at 311,909, 62,452 and 3,765,656 ULP, and the F-sharp reference is off too. The source classes the state as all_diverge and explicitly not accepted, and the catalogue confirms the drift is pure schedule and publication now that the forward price is fixed -- ODDFYIELD shares the YIELD solver machine and its iterate-publication wall. This record exists to hold the absence: any per-surface ODDFYIELD pass figure is a fabrication, and the 5/5 and 10/10 printed under the same row belong to ODDFPRICE.
